instructions: To ask one subagent to solve a task, emit {"action":"delegate","agent":"reviewer","purpose":"review","task":"Read the relevant files and report findings."}. For independent tasks use {"action":"delegate_many","agents":[{"agent":"first","purpose":"review","task":"Task A"},{"agent":"second","purpose":"review","task":"Task B"}]}. An optional profile selects a configured model profile. Keep agent names unique per batch and respect the host batch limit. Wait for HOST_RESULT; inspect each child status and combine their findings. Use serial delegation for dependent work and multiple bounded batches for larger collective tasks.
